title: Azusawa Kohane — Smile Hued By Dusk〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Hotel - Cafe Entrance

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Morning, everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Morning, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Toya & Akito
rows.Line:
Good morning.
Morning.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
Hotels seriously have the best beds. I slept like a baby last night!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, you're able to fall asleep basically anywhere.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, you knew?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anyway, let's go have breakfa—

rows.Speaker: Guest A
rows.Line: “I didn't think we'd actually stay at this hotel. What if those rumors are true...?”

rows.Speaker: Guest B
rows.Line:
“Hahaha! You're kidding, right?
There's no way we're gonna see any ghosts.”

rows.Speaker: Guest A
rows.Line: “But I saw people online saying how a guest unexpectedly died with no clear cause...”

rows.Speaker: Guest B
rows.Line: “You mean that whole thing about how they became a ghost, and they're still wandering the halls? I didn't think you were superstitious like that.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(This hotel's rumored to be haunted?
But Taiga's manager didn't mention anything when he booked our rooms...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Umm...
Did you also understand what they just said, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I couldn't help it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To think that all your English studying would come back to haunt you in this way.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-Are you sure you're going to be okay, An...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: D-Dunno. What are ghosts and monsters outside of Japan like?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
They're pretty grotesque...
Remember that zombie wolf we saw at Miya Girls during their school festival? The exact opposite of forgettable—

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, stop.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
D-Don't worry, An!
If that's what we're dealing with, then I promise to keep you safe from them!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know! I'll stay right by your side for the rest of the day!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Y-You'll come with me when I use the bathroom...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And when I take a bath?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll stand guard right outside the door and keep an eye out for any ghosts or monsters!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ko...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohaneeeee!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If that helps put Shiraishi at ease, then I see no problem with you doing that, but...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you planning on doing that the entire time we're at this hotel?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ugh... Yeah, that'd be asking too much...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, I'll check to see if those rumors are true!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Those people just said how they found that information online. So, I should be able to find it as well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I got a few hits after searching this hotel's name plus “ghosts”. Let's see... The place with the most sightings is...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, wait! Are you sure about this, Kohane?! Salt and stuff probably doesn't work on American ghosts, right?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right...
I don't think using salt to purify places is a part of their culture.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you guys are hung up on that?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, here's some information about morning and noon sightings...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You guys can start eating without me!
I'm going to go see what happens!
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, Azusawa!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright... I guess that means we should go with her, huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You stay here and wait.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You're joking, right?!
I'm not about to put my partner in harm's way!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, I don't wanna be left all alone here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why are you acting so proud?
The next day

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We spent the entire day checking out the places people mentioned, but we didn't end up seeing any ghosts.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, they were just rumors.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, how did that saying go? Where there's fire, there's smoke or something?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Regarding that, I did some digging last night and found an interesting article.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Last year, this hotel featured a ghost character during the Halloween event they held. In terms of timing, it matches perfectly with the sightings you mentioned.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, that means...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So, it was a character for an event?
And people thought it was real?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Apparently.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's great, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah! Now I can finally relax!
Thanks for figuring out this mystery, you guys!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me! Since we were all at our wit's end thinking about ghosts last night, let's all have a pajama party tonight!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow, that sounds like fun!
We need to go buy some snacks and drinks!
